Description

Catechol-O-methyltransferase inactivates noradrenaline and adrenaline by methylating them, giving normetanephrine and metanephrine. Common variants of the COMT gene lower its activity and are linked to higher pain sensitivity, and the Val158Met variant is associated with pain in OA. In rats, inhibiting COMT raises pain through β2 and β3 adrenoceptors.
